payload.body: utilz-dc to vc: START (light, then a kovacs leg), the v5 rerun after 148's red: ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/work/run-0083-v5.sh. v5 is a1f2c584, the same 28 paths, and only test 17's refute changed: it now refutes "sudo apt install xclip" and "sudo apt install wl-clipboard", the clipz tools' own lines, where it refuted any apt line. Mac, in wt-0083: (1) test 17 by name, bash 3.2 then 5. (2) M1, M2 and a new M3 by text, each restored and checked by hash. M3 puts the install line into the purpose of a dependency this platform cannot have, on the line before the platform note is collected; test 17 must go red at its new refutes while its "Linux only" asserts still hold. Then kovacs: the utilz suite alone at v5 (record c0083-a1f2c584, kovacs checks out 590441f) under a perl alarm of 1800 s, with its run dir removed by name on a nonzero exit. Linux verdict from 148's diagnostics, read: macoz is "macOS only, not available on Linux", counted as nothing; Hammerspoon and hs are "macOS only" with no install line; fileicon is skipped with macoz; xclip is an optional dependency with its apt line. Asking your GO; 0083's landing START follows this END.
